summary: Tested the new Cronos sync feature end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass covering export.json, sync/status (admin+viewer), sync run (admin success & idempotency, viewer 403), source add validation (http rejected 422, https accepted 201, broken source returns ok:false while existing source stays ok, delete 200 + 404 on re-delete), and cron /api/cron/sync (401 without bearer, 200 accepted with secret + X-Webhook-Id). Frontend (Playwright, admin cookie): sync-now-button is visible, click triggers sync and sync-last label updates to today (2026-10-06), kpi-total-credits unchanged at 1380 cr. In /ajustes the sync-sources-panel shows the existing source; adding Test UI/https://example.com/abc creates a new row with masked token …abc; deleting via confirm dialog removes it. Viewer cookie confirms sync-now-button is NOT rendered. The self-source 'Prueba (Cronos mismo)' and all entries/wiki docs were preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: cronos.py has grown to ~1100 lines; sync code (fetch_source/run_sync/routes) could be extracted to a dedicated module (sync.py) for maintainability.

sync source tokens are stored in plain-text inside cronos_settings (sync_sources). Masking at response level is fine but consider at-rest encryption or Mongo field-level encryption for the token field.
fetch_source sets both Authorization: Bearer and X-API-Key to the same token; some remote apps may reject this duplication — consider configurable auth style per source.
SyncSourceIn.base_url is validated as https only inside add_sync_source (manual check) instead of a pydantic validator — move to a validator so OpenAPI schema reflects the constraint.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data; preserved the existing sync source 'Prueba (Cronos mismo)'. The transient 'Fuente rota' and UI 'Test UI' sources were created and deleted within tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend sync tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_sync.py (reusable regression). The only configured source is self-sync 'Prueba (Cronos mismo)' pointing at the app itself using the admin test session token. Do NOT delete it. Entries count is 19 and sync is idempotent (count stays 19 after re-sync).
rca of the issue: N/A — all sync feature acceptance criteria met.
